item.title: All In One SEO WordPress Vulnerability Affects Over 3 Million Sites
item.description: A vulnerability in the AIOSEO plugin affecting up to 3 million installations adds to the six vulnerabilities found in 2025.

item.title: Google Health AI Overviews Cite YouTube More Than Any Hospital Site
item.description: A study of 50,807 German health queries finds Google AI Overviews cite YouTube most, as Google pulls some health summaries after a Guardian report.

item.title: WordPress Membership Plugin Flaw Exposes Sensitive Stripe Data
item.description: WordPress membership plugin vulnerability exposing sensitive Stripe payment data affects up to 10,000 websites.

item.title: 10 Remarketing Lists To Boost PPC Performance
item.description: Discover 10 remarketing lists PPC managers can use to reduce wasted spend, prioritize high-intent users, and improve campaign performance.

item.title: PPC Pulse: Total Budgets Expand, Direct Offers, & Shopping Promotions
item.description: Google expands campaign total budgets, tests Direct Offers in AI Mode, and updates Shopping promotion policies, reshaping how advertisers plan spend and promotions.

item.title: SEO Pulse: UCP Debate, Trends Gets Gemini, Health AIO Concerns
item.description: Google's Universal Commerce Protocol sparks pricing debate, Trends Explore adds Gemini suggestions, and health AI Overviews face scrutiny after Guardian reporting.

item.title: ChatGPT To Begin Testing Ads In The United States
item.description: OpenAI will begin testing ads for ChatGPT Free and Go users in the U.S., outlining strict guardrails around privacy, answer independence, and ad placement.

item.title: Google On Phantom Noindex Errors In Search Console
item.description: Google's John Mueller's response on phantom noindex errors in Search Console acknowledges indexing blocks visible to Google.

item.description: Learn which strategies matter now and where marketers should shift budgets for stronger, more reliable performance this year.
